 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

sentences.text:
Ms. Pronoy Mohanty, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr. S. Patra, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s. 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.294/323/506/420/406/107/468/471/120B of IPC,
Section 4/5/6 of Prizes Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning Act), 1978 and Section 6 of the OPID, (in Financial Establishment) Act, 2011 in connection with Kabisurya Nagar PS Case No.191 of 2015 corresponding to GR Case No. pending in the court of learned SDJM, Padampur.

entities.text: Prizes Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning Act), 1978
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. This is the third successive journey of the Petitioner seeking grant of pre-arrest bail.
According to learned counsel for the Petitioner the coordinate Bench of this Court has granted liberty in favour of one Anil Kumar Nayak, the co-accused in this case.

According to learned counsel for the Petitioner,
the aforesaid // 2 // Court while granting bail has held the face value of the liability in respect to the allegation is restricted to Rs.2.5 lakh.
Perusal of the relevant order, however, reveals that the coordinate Bench has mentioned about at paragraph No.5 about submission of learned counsel.
There is, however, no specific observation of the Court as regards acceptance of the amount to be liability in connection with the case.

4. Be that as it may, as stated earlier by this court while disposing the ABLAPL No.14017 of 2022,
according to the State, the Petitioners are promoters in respect of Ketloan Credit Cooperative Society Ltd. and having assured the investors to give double the deposited amount in three years Aswini Kumar Nayak vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175074150/
1 alleged to have collected Rs.14,32,00/- from 36 investors and the whereabouts of the said Organizers as well as the Promoters are not known as yet.

entities.text: Aswini Kumar Nayak vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present bail application seems to have been filed before this Court pursuant to the name disclosed in the year 2019, as submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioners.

5. Having regard to the nature of allegation and the offence alleged against the Petitioners and the aforesaid submissions, while this Court is not inclined to pass any order, in the event he surrenders in the court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case within three weeks, the court shall pass appropriate order in accordance with law keeping in view the gravity of the offence, the injuries and severity of the punishment on its own merit independently applying its wisdom allowing or rejecting the application not being influenced by the direction passed herein for // 3 // disposal of application in any manner.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
6. The Petitioner is at liberty to place the order passed in BLAPL No.11491 of 2022 for appreciation of the court.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge AKPradhan Signed by: ANANTA KUMAR PRADHAN
